name: Green Beans
description: Green Beans on LOOM with persistent shopping, first-class Meal Creator composition, project identity, protected Admin tooling, and optional MySQL/MariaDB permanence.
bio: Green Beans is the family food app that turns "what are we doing for dinner?" into a plan, a shopping list and a table full of happy people. Say what you need, approve what you like and share the good stuff. Plan. Eat. Share.
